purpose: This record binds the status LED fit to Derek’s photographed prewired lamp and distinguishes physical measurements from allocated clearance.
part: CHANZON prewired clear-lens blue LED, with inline resistor and blue positive/black negative leads

flange_diameter_mm.basis: Derek identifies the flange in photo-6.jpg.

body_diameter_mm.basis: Derek identifies the body above the flange; photo-7.jpg shows the caliper reading.

photographed_bent_height_mm.basis: Caliper reading in photo-5.jpg, interpreted as dome-to-outside-bend height. This is not the straight insulated-tail length.

nominal_lens_length_mm.basis: Existing product-drawing dimension; not newly measured in these photographs.

clearance_allocation.basis: A conservative design envelope around the photographed resistor, solder joints and heat-shrink. Tail length and width are allowances, not caliper measurements of the acquired part.

assembly.entry: Place the complete lamp, resistor and heat-shrink through the open service pocket with the status plate removed.
assembly.route: A straight tail extends into the well. An already formed tail lies up the slot without reforming the leads. Flexible wires turn through the rear cross passage into the common pump/display corridor.
assembly.handling: Keep force off the epoxy-to-lead joint and the resistor and solder joints. Do not straighten the already bent example to force it through the socket.

handling_reference.scope: General through-hole LED handling guidance; not a CHANZON-specific bend qualification.

assembly.retention: Set the lens back behind the diffuser and tack the flange to the socket with the existing hot-glue gun, keeping adhesive off optical faces. Let the adhesive cool before handling.

qualification: Digital fit and insertion checks; physical fit in the printed revised housing is not yet reported.
